thread:
alex_k: Heads-up: telemetry shows regional relay pools are exhausting ephemeral peering slots at peak. Current LRU eviction is kicking out paying customers. Need an eviction policy design that respects tiering and sticky routes.

mira: Ugh saw that too. LRU is too dumb for multi-tenant lanes. We should add explicit priority + idle detection.

jia: Proposal sketch: assign tier label (enterprise, paid, free) and compute a score for each lease. Evict lowest score. Score = tier_weight * 1000 - active_streams - min(idle_seconds, 3600).

sam: How to define "idle"? Some customers send tiny pings. If we use last_request_ts we might evict during short quiet windows.

alex_k: Use last_request_ts plus KV cache hit activity. Idle if last_request_ts older than threshold AND kv_cache_hits==0. Threshold = 5m for free/paid, 30m for enterprise.

mira: Also need "sticky" label: pinned endpoints or customers who set a sticky flag via console. Sticky should reduce eviction weight heavily.

oliver: Implementation idea: leader in each region runs deterministic eviction loop every 15s; writes decisions to a decision-log topic for audit. Pre-eviction: call pre-eviction/drain endpoint on connector to mark route read-only for 60s, send telemetry, then tear-down.

jia: Add a cool-down window: after eviction, block re-establishment for 10m with exponential backoff + jitter to avoid oscillation. Emit churn metric.

sam: We should surface a manual pin in console and an API to pin/unpin for ops. Pins must be auditable and auto-expire.

mira: Product policy: customers can define allowed_fallbacks in their manifest (regional-global, lower-cost-model, queued). Infra implements fallback mechanics, product defines allowed paths per tier.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Eviction-service v2 canary scheduled 2026-06-15 18:00 UTC.

oliver: Security: when evicting, rotate ephemeral route tokens and log revocation. Confirmed with sec that KMS calls are async to avoid hot path latency.

jia: Metrics to emit: eviction_reason, evicted_peer_id, pre_eviction_score, idle_seconds, active_streams, churn_indicator. Alert on >5% regional evictions in 10m.

alex_k: Ops runbook: mass-eviction (>5% peers in 10m) should page oncall and auto-open incident with attached logs.

sam: Docs/pricing: update SLA language: free = best-effort ephemeral slots, paid = higher eviction protection, enterprise = reserved slots. Contract team needs grace-window numbers.

mira: Edge cases: cross-account peers where private control plane lives in customer VPC. Can't tear down without notifying them. Add pre-eviction webhook and require ACK within 30s for forced teardown.

jia: Implementation tasks: 1) scoring prototype and simulation (jia), 2) pre-eviction drain API + webhook (oliver), 3) console pin UX + audit (product/ux), 4) metrics + alerts + dashboards (sam).

alex_k: Please open RFC PRs with sample scoring formulas, API sketches, example logs, and playbook snippets. Tag reviewers.

infra-bot: calendar-bot: Follow-up sync Tue 2026-06-16 09:00 PT in #architecture.

sam: I'll draft metrics and alerts doc.

mira: I'll coordinate customer policy manifest schema with product.

jia: Will push scoring spike branch and link.

oliver: Starting drain API proto and a canary mock.

alex_k: Thanks everyone  let's avoid surprise evictions next week.
